p: Gird up thy loins: Prepare yourself to go diligently about your business for in those countries they used long garments which they tucked up when they went about earnest business.
anointed thee king over the people: This anointing was for kings, priests and prophets which were all figures of Messiah, in whom these three offices were accomplished.
servants of his lord: That is, the rest of the army, whom he called his brethren before, 2Ki 9:2.

mad fellow to thee: The world always holds the ministers of God is this estimation and has always slandered the children of God (they called the Son of God a deceiver, and said he had the devil) therefore they should not be discouraged.

Ahaziah king of Judah was come: God had thus ordained as in 2Ch 12:7, that this wicked and idolatrous king, who was more ready to please wicked Joram than to obey the will of God, would perish with him, by whose means he thought to have been stronger.
furiously: As one that went earnestly about his business.
peace: Meaning, since God is their enemy because of their sins, he will always stir up someone to avenge his cause.
sons: By this it is evident that Jezebel caused both Naboth and his sons to be put to death, that Ahab might enjoy his vineyard more quietly: else his children might have claimed possession.
Megiddo: After he was wounded in Samaria, he fled to Megiddo, a city of Judah.
eleventh year of Joram the son: That is, eleven whole years: for in 2Ki 8:25 when he said he began to reign in the twelfth year of Joram, he takes a partial year for a whole.
looked out at a window: Being of a harsh and cruel nature, she would still retain her royal state and dignity.
Zimri peace: As if to say, "Can a traitor or anyone who rises against his superior succeed?", see 1Ki 16:10.

and some of her blood was: This he did by the moving of the Spirit of God, that her blood would be shed, who had shed the blood of innocents, to be a spectacle and example of God's judgment for all tyrants.
king's daughter: That is, of the king of Zidon, 1Ki 16:31.
This is Jezebel: Thus God's judgments appear even in this world against those who suppress his word and persecute his servants.
